FullCalendar 6.1.22 Standard bundle, Luxon 3.7.2 and the MIT FullCalendar Luxon3 adapter.
Exact npm provenance, bundled versions and file hashes: docs/dependencies/fullcalendar-manifest.json.
All licenses are retained under licenses/. No Premium resource/scheduler code is included.
The pinned v6 line was updated October 16, 2026, alongside v7.1.3. Its browser API fits this pilot.
fullcalendar-with-timezone.js is the exact newline concatenation of luxon.min.js, fullcalendar.min.js and luxon3-plugin.min.js; the vendor gate verifies that derivation.
